provenance.source: Primary Land Use Tax Lot Output (PLUTO)
provenance.license: NYC Open Data Terms of Use (https://www.nyc.gov/home/terms-of-use.page)
provenance.method: Tax-lot attributes for the 2458 distinct BBLs referenced by frozen footprints (mappluto_bbl, else base_bbl).
caveats: PLUTO describes tax lots, not buildings: land use is the lot's, and numfloors is the tallest building on the lot.
Administrative records compiled from several city agencies; not a field survey.
